description: This Java source file defines the 'SearchInvoke' activity within an Android application. The activity provides a user interface for initiating search actions with configurable options, including different menu modes and prefilled query data. It handles menu creation, configuration, and search requests, demonstrating how to invoke and customize search behavior in an Android app.

classes.name: SearchInvoke
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates invoking and controlling search functionality with various menu modes and prefilled data inputs.

methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting up UI components and event listeners.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Dynamically updates the options menu based on the current menu mode.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of menu items, providing user guidance or triggering search actions.

methods.name: onSearchRequested
methods.description: Handles the initiation of a search action, optionally prefilled with user input and including context data.

methods.name: clearSearchHistory
methods.description: Clears the recent search history stored for suggestions.
